facts.label: Revisão
facts.sub: Use who e that para descrever, o passado para contar e -er than / the -est para comparar.

facts.label: que (pessoa/coisa)

facts.label: passado

compare.ask: It was the best meal of my life.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “o mais doce”, “melhor do que” e “tão bom quanto”.
compare.tip: Diga: “It was the best meal of my life.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use -er than ou more… than para comparar duas coisas, the -est ou the most… para o superlativo e as… as para igualdade. Com adjetivos curtos: sweet, sweeter, the sweetest. O irregular é good, better, the best.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: It was the best meal of my life.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: A restaurant in Melbourne · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday night in Melbourne. Alma and Marco walk down a small street. Warm light comes from a restaurant window. Alma stops at the door and smiles. She came here one year ago. Now she wants to share the place.

“Marco, this is the restaurant that I visited last year. It was the best meal of my life.” says Alma. “Really? What made it so special?” says Marco. “The chef, who came from a small village, cooked everything himself.” says Alma.
